what: FINDING_1: Runtime discussion-round cancel paths still point at the removed Terminal cost line
scenario_or_breakage: The plan only updates skills/design/SKILL.md callsites, but this loaded reference still tells Step 1c/1d semantic-sprawl cancellations to run ### Terminal cost line; after the proposed replacement, those exits either reference a missing block or skip the new final summary entirely.
suggested_fix: Update discussion-rounds.md to call the Final summary block, define the outcome string for semantic-sprawl cancellation, and include that outcome in render-run-summary.md plus the design dispatcher tests.

what: FINDING_2: The planned cancelled-plan-size-soft path does not exist in the current soft-trigger contract
scenario_or_breakage: Step 2b.5 soft branch currently offers only Split and Continue; the plan's soft/partition/semantic Cancel outcome is therefore either unreachable test surface or an unacknowledged UX/control-flow change in a cost-line consolidation PR.
suggested_fix: Either remove cancelled-plan-size-soft from the implementation/tests and keep Split as the only exiting soft path, or explicitly revise the soft AskUserQuestion contract to add Cancel and document why this behavioral change belongs in the PR.

what: FINDING_3: The plan strips token-report --summary cost output but misses an existing linted harness that still requires it
scenario_or_breakage: make lint includes test-token-report, whose summary cases assert Cost: TOTAL and vendor dollar slots; updating only test-token-report-summary-format.sh leaves CI failing even if token-report.sh is correctly changed.
suggested_fix: Update scripts/test-token-report.sh to assert absence of the dollar-primary line and presence of the replacement token/bucket output, matching the new summary contract.

what: FINDING_4: The proposed render-cost-line callsite grep will fail on docs the plan does not update
scenario_or_breakage: test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh is planned to allow only render-cost-line.md and its harness docs under scripts, but token-report.md and token-cost.md still mention render-cost-line.sh, so the invariant will fail or force an over-broad exception.
suggested_fix: Update token-report.md and token-cost.md to describe render-run-summary/token-cost as the authoritative path and render-cost-line.sh as deprecated/manual, or narrow the test to executable callsites instead of documentation mentions.

what: FINDING_5: Upsert-failure warnings are appended after the summary has already been rendered and printed
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed helper renders with --print-stdout, then attempts tracking-issue-summary.sh, then appends a Warnings entry on failure; chat and final-summary.md remain byte-aligned but under-report the warning count and omit the final-summary publish failure.
suggested_fix: Render first to a temp file without printing, attempt the upsert, append any upsert failure warning, then rerender final-summary.md and print stdout from the final content; only the GitHub comment uses the pre-failure body when the upsert succeeds.
